title.narrative: Facility for Low Carbon Technology Deployment

description.narrative: The project aims to facilitate deployment and scaling up of low carbon technologies in India that can address technology gaps to mitigate climate change and promote use of energy efficiency and renewable energy technologies and systems in selected sectors.
